subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Sluggish
solution:
The correct answer is “**Active**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• '**Sluggish**' means slow-moving or not active, likely due to lethargy or lack of energy. (सुस्त)

 
 
• **Example**- He was sluggish in the morning, but after a coffee, he became quite active.
 
 
 
• '**Active**' implies being brisk or full of energy and movement. (सक्रिय)
 
 
• **Example**- Despite the lack of sleep, she remained active throughout the day.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is Opposite in meaning to 'Sluggish' is 'Active'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• '**Flatter**' means to lavish praise or compliments on someone, often to gain favor. (चापलूसी करना) 
 
• '**Humiliate**' means to make someone feel ashamed or foolish by injuring their dignity and pride. (अपमानित करना) 
 
• '**Lethargic**' means a lack of energy and enthusiasm. (अलसी)
